items.approach: roundtrip.py: extend round_trip_ok with two deterministic rejections. (1) Negation: module regex _NEGATION = r"\b(do not|don't|dont|never|avoid|must not|mustn't|should not|shouldn't|without|not)\b" (IGNORECASE); any match anywhere in text appends mismatch "negation" (a one-action manifest step never warrants a negated instruction; the template never produces one). (2) Extra action clause: build _ANY_ACTION as the union of _CLICK_VERBS, _TYPE_VERBS and a small destructive/other list (delete|remove|erase|wipe|format|reformat|uninstall|disable|run|execute|restart|reboot|kill|terminate|drop|close|install|launch|rename|move|clear|reset); before counting, mask every case-insensitive occurrence of step.element.name and step.window.title in the text with spaces (so an element literally named Save/Close/Open/Run is not counted as a verb); if the masked text has more than one _ANY_ACTION match append mismatch "extra_action". Return (len(mismatches)==0, mismatches) as before. generation.py needs no change: generate_step_text already falls back to render_step_template on any mismatch, so both probe strings now yield the template text, which is always factually correct.
